litigation.court: U.S. District Court for the District of Oregon
litigation.case_title: Annika Eriksson and Donald Buckhout v. City of Oregon City, Tony Konkol, Ramon Henderson, Alexandra Troutman, Ashley Fraijo, John Oreskovich, Vance Walker
litigation.defendants: City of Oregon City, Tony Konkol, Ramon Henderson, Alexandra Troutman, Ashley Fraijo, John Oreskovich, Vance Walker
litigation.cause_of_action: Civil rights: municipal water shutoff, ADA accommodation denial, property seizure under color of law

financial.savings_and_pto_notes: Applicant has no employment income, liquid savings, or real estate assets. Lives on severe low-income hardship.
financial.hardship_statement: Co-Applicant Donald Buckhout has $0.00 earned income, no active employment, and < $50 in total liquid assets. Applicant suffers severe medical disability and financial hardship. Hardship is compounded by Defendant City's 510-day illegal municipal water shutoff and concrete vault placement at the joint residence. Co-Applicant cannot pay the $405 federal filing fee without forfeiting essential food, shelter, and medical necessities of life.
